manifestations.invariant: When a courier declines an assignment after the batch lock, the locked snapshot retains its integrity while the order is recorded once at its original priority.

contract_bindings.quote: The batch optimizer keeps its locked-assignment snapshot unchanged at batch lock so its integrity accounting stays reliable.
The refusal regression requires the ready queue to record the order once at its original priority.
